certifiedResults.title: Mississippi official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential results are parsed from a normalized county-total CSV generated from the Mississippi Secretary of State 2024 General Election Recapitulation Sheets CSV. The live SOS CSV is protected from plain HTTP collection in this environment, so the build stores an archived official snapshot plus the normalized app-ready extract.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Wayback capture of the Mississippi Secretary of State 2024 General Election Recapitulation Sheets CSV.

wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS recap sheet provides county rows but not app-ready precinct comparison rows.
